title: Topic 5.4: Reading 5.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story

pages.lesson:
LESSON: READING 5.4.1 INTENSIVE READING: SHORT STORY

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.4: Reading 5.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Reading 5.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What makes stories interesting to read?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify dialogue and repetition in a short story
2. explain the importance of repetition and dialogue in a short story

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify dialogue and repetition in a short story
   In simple words: practise until you can identify dialogue and repetition in a short story. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. explain the importance of repetition and dialogue in a short story
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the importance of repetition and dialogue in a short story. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Reading 5.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Reading 5.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story in the examples.
2. Explain Reading 5.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reading 5.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story.
4. Show that you can: identify dialogue and repetition in a short story

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 5.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 5.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read a short story and work with peers to retell what they have read,
2. Discuss the message in the dialogue in a short story,
3. Role play a dialogue in the short story read,

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify dialogue and repetition in a short story
2. explain the importance of repetition and dialogue in a short story

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
